chapter: Paul Mares and the Rhythm Kings
title: Paul's last band in 1934 and his death
summary: Paul's last job was at Harry's New Yorker in 1934; he tried to assemble a band in New Orleans, then fell ill and died August 18, 1949.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
